description:
Hand-Carved Style Smoking Pipe
Churchwarden Long Stem Design
Faux Wood Finish, 17 Inches Long, With Box
This churchwarden-style smoking pipe features a characteristically long stem and an elegantly engraved bowl. The churchwarden silhouette, known for providing a cooler smoke due to the distance the smoke travels, gained historical popularity and remains a favorite for themed collections or leisurely use. This modern interpretation features a deep burgundy faux-grain finish with intricate scrollwork carvings on the bowl, capturing a vintage aesthetic.
Long 17-inch churchwarden silhouette for a cool smoking experience
Detailed floral and scrollwork engravings on the bowl surface
Three-piece detachable construction including stem, bowl, and mouthpiece
Includes original presentation box with satin-style lining
Condition:
The pipe is in excellent structural condition. The exterior finish is glossy and intact with no visible chips or deep scratches. The bowl interior appears clean and unused. The mouthpiece and stem connectors are secure. The original presentation box shows minor storage wear but remains fully intact. Warehouse Location: Cleveland

Description:
Add a touch of historic charm to your decor or collection with this genuine Hemingray-42 glass insulator in striking aqua blue. Renowned for their iconic craftsmanship and durability, Hemingray insulators were essential on telephone and telegraph lines in the early-to-mid-20th century. This piece features beautiful embossed branding, a thick glass body, and a delightful beaded rim detail, making it both visually attractive and functional. Whether displayed as a standalone accent, repurposed for creative DIY projects, or included in a larger antique glass collection, this insulator offers lasting appeal and nostalgia. Own a slice of industrial history, manufactured in the USA and sure to impress both collectors and design enthusiasts alike. Buy confidently, knowing this is an authentic vintage piece, ideal for gifting or personal enjoyment.

Shipping information
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Items with a Fixed/Flat shipping fee (rather than calculated) will ship by the cheapest method, which may not match what was stated in the listing. FedEx does not ship to P.O. boxes or APO/FPO addresses.
Please be sure to enter an address that we can ship to when you check out. Your package will be insured, regardless of mail class or carrier, however, insurance DOES NOT cover theft after delivery.
If you require a specific carrier, signature confirmation, or have a special packing/handling request, please make your needs known by clicking Contact Seller prior to making payment so that we can add applicable fees for service(s) requested. We have accounts with FedEx and USPS only.

description:
Cross
Classic Century Pen and Pencil Set - Lustrous Chrome
Vintage 1980s, Ribbed Pinstripe Design
This Cross Classic Century set features the slim, elegant silhouette that has defined the brand's professional writing instruments for decades. Crafted in polished chrome with a distinctive vertical pinstripe texture, this set represents the mid-century modern aesthetic that transitioned into a timeless corporate standard. Both pieces feature the signature conical top and twist-action mechanism that are hallmarks of American precision manufacturing.
Polished chrome finish with vertical ribbed pinstripe engraving
Includes original ballpoint pen and matching mechanical pencil
Authentic "Cross Made in USA" stamps on crowns and brand logo on clips
Personalized engravings: "Mrs. Harmon 88" and "To a Special Teacher 88"
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with minimal signs of surface wear to the chrome finish. The original presentation box is included and is in good structural condition with minor storage wear. The set includes the original guarantee and instruction booklet.
POLICIES and Seller Info
How to reach us-
Per the policies of our selling location, we do not remove unpaid items or cancel bids. Thank you for understanding!
Sending a message via shopgoodwill.com message is the only way to reach us and receive a response. Your concerns are very important to us, but we do not have a business phone on site. Calls to the home office cannot be transferred to us, so if you call and leave a message, you are guaranteed NOT to receive a response and we don't want that! Customer services messages are checked throughout the day, Monday through Friday (excluding holidays), between the hours of 9am and 4pm eastern time.
Domestic Shipping-
Items with a Fixed/Flat shipping fee (rather than calculated) will ship the cheapest possible way, FedEx shipping is not guaranteed on items with a fixed shipping cost. FedEx does not ship to P.O. boxes or APO/FPO addresses. Please enter an address that we can ship to at check out.
Your package will be insured, regardless of mail class or carrier, however, insurance DOES NOT cover theft after delivery. Porch piracy is very common so we strongly suggest that you use your DAYTIME address you will be available to receive your package. If you require a specific carrier, signature confirmation, or have a special packing/handling request, please make your needs known by clicking Contact Seller prior to making payment so that we can add applicable fees for service(s) requested. We have accounts with FedEx and USPS only.
Handling-
Items like instruments, artwork, delicate collectibles, stereo receivers, and sewing machines require additional packing materials and labor to pack them safely. For this reason, handling fees are higher on specialty items.
Handling fees cap at $15 on combined orders. So if you combine 10 items with a $2 each handling fee, the system will automatically discount your shipping price and your handling would be $15 rather than $20. (This applies to items combined from Chattanooga Area Goodwill only).
General Disclaimers-
All items are donated and in used condition unless otherwise specified. Please manage your expectations accordingly.
Colors may vary depending on the settings of your monitor. Items are measured by hand, and are may vary by 1-3cm.
All items have potentially been exposed to pets and/or other allergens. Returns are not authorized for odors, ever, under any circumstance. If you are sensitive to allergens and/or odors, we recommend that you not purchase pre-owned items.
We typically do not authorize returns, so it is VERY important that you read the full description, carefully view all photos, and ask any questions you may have PRIOR to placing bids. Pictures are considered a part of the item description. Any item returned without prior authorization from the seller will be considered a donation and re-sold.
Special Disclaimers (
whenever applicable
)-
Our Presidium Gem Tester is able to identify the gemstone family or families based on the hardness of the tested gem. We are not certified gemologists, so we are not always able to determine the specific gemstone(s) present, differentiate between certain stones, or confirm the device's findings.
Most of the world's pearls are cultured. The ability to differentiate between cultured, freshwater, and natural (ocean) pearls is beyond the scope of our equipment.
Unless otherwise stated above, all marked metals are tested by our Thermo Scientific Niton DXL Precious Metal Analyzer. Photos will be provided in listing of results. If not, a precious metal it will be listed and Gold/Silver Tone or plated.
Some listings may contain a mixture of fine jewelry AND costume jewelry. Please read full description to understand what you are buying. Items described as costume jewelry are presumed to not include precious metals, regardless of any markings you may see in photos.
Local Pick Up-
We do not have local pickup. All items will be shipped.  If you'd like to have it shipped to your place of business instead of a residential address. Please contact us with any shipping questions.
International Shipping-
INTERNATIONAL BUYERS' OUTSIDE OF THE USA AND CANADA are not eligible for any shipping discounts including flat rate or penny shipping. Contact us via Shopgoodwill.com message for an estimate prior to bidding on any items with discounted shipping.

How Photography Affects Size Perception
Macro (extreme close-up) photography is heavily utilized in jewelry listings, enabling viewers to examine pieces in larger-than-life detail. An accurate understanding of the actual sizes of these pieces cannot be deduced using photos alone. It is important that the bidder takes close note of the measurements and weights to determine actual sizes.
About Gemstone & Metal Testing
Gemstones are tested with a Presidium Gem Tester. Goodwill of the Olympics & Rainier Region is a member of the International Gem Society; however, as we are not certified gemologists, we cannot guarantee the authenticity of any gemstone unless otherwise stated. Gemstone identification information is provided for your reference and consideration in bidding; no guarantee is implied.
Pearls are tested with a check for grittiness to detect nacre irregularities. We are generally unable to specify pearl types and characteristics; they may be cultured, wild, freshwater or saltwater pearls. Coral may be natural or dyed; most of our coral listings include dyed pieces.
Metals including Gold, Silver, and Platinum are tested using an XRF precious metal analyzer, the Niton XL2 by Thermo Scientific, unless explicitly noted otherwise. XRF (X-ray fluorescence) analysis is a non-destructive testing method able to determine an item's elemental composition. Identification of other non-magnetic metals, including brass, bronze, copper, tin, and titanium, rely on our best estimation, and no guarantee is implied; they have not been tested or positively identified unless explicitly noted otherwise. Some jewelry may contain non-precious metals in clasps or findings, causing parts of the piece to respond to a magnet.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 12 Insulator
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Antique/Vintage
Authentic Hemingray No. 12 glass insulator, a classic piece of American industrial history. Produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, this model was widely used for telephone and telegraph lines during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It features the signature aqua blue glass and technical design elements common to the era's utility infrastructure.
Embossed "HEMINGRAY NO. 12" on the front skirt
Embossed "PATENT MAY 2 1893" on the reverse side
Sharp drip points along the bottom base edge designed to shed moisture
Translucent aqua blue glass with characteristic manufacturing seed bubbles and swirls
Approximately 3.75 inches tall by 3 inches wide
Condition:
Significant chip and glass loss on the bottom skirt edge as shown in photographs. Minor surface soot and mineral deposits within the interior threads and grooves. Main dome and upper wire grooves remain structurally sound. Original glass color is vibrant with no internal stress cracks.
